function label<T extends new (...args: any[]) => object>(Base: T) {
  return class extends Base { label = "item"; };
}
class Box { constructor(public value: number) {} }
const Labeled = label(Box);
new Labeled("text");
new Labeled();

function fixed<T extends new (value: string) => object>(Base: T) {
  return class extends Base {};
}
function wrong<T extends new (...args: any[]) => object>(Base: T) {
  return class extends Base {
    constructor(value: string) { super(value); }
  };
}
function abstractBase<T extends abstract new (...args: any[]) => object>(Base: T) {
  return class extends Base {};
}
